description: HAVING with COUNT/SUM/AVG, aliases, multiple conditions, without GROUP BY, filter-all. Converted 1:1 from query/HavingTest.java (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (customer VARCHAR, amount INT)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES ('Alice', 100), ('Alice', 200), ('Bob', 150), ('Charlie', 300), ('Charlie', 250), ('Charlie', 180)
SELECT customer, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
CREATE TABLE sales (region VARCHAR, amount INT)
INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('East', 1000), ('East', 1500), ('West', 800), ('West', 600), ('North', 2000)
SELECT region, SUM(amount) as total FROM sales GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) > 2000
CREATE TABLE scores (student VARCHAR, score INT)
INSERT INTO scores VALUES ('Alice', 90), ('Alice', 85), ('Alice', 95), ('Bob', 70), ('Bob', 75), ('Charlie', 95), ('Charlie', 98)
SELECT student, AVG(score) as avg_score FROM scores GROUP BY student HAVING AVG(score) >= 90 ORDER BY student
CREATE TABLE transactions (acct_id VARCHAR, amount INT)
INSERT INTO transactions VALUES ('A', 100), ('A', 200), ('A', 150), ('B', 50), ('B', 75)
SELECT acct_id, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY acct_id HAVING total_amount > 200
CREATE TABLE sales_data (category VARCHAR, quantity INT, price INT)
INSERT INTO sales_data VALUES ('Electronics', 5, 100), ('Electronics', 3, 150), ('Books', 10, 20), ('Books', 15, 25), ('Clothing', 8, 50)
SELECT category, SUM(quantity) as total_qty, COUNT(*) as num_sales FROM sales_data GROUP BY category HAVING SUM(quantity) > 5
CREATE TABLE numbers (value INT)
INSERT INTO numbers VALUES (10), (20), (30)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM numbers HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
CREATE TABLE items (category VARCHAR, count INT)
INSERT INTO items VALUES ('A', 1), ('B', 2), ('C', 3)
SELECT category, SUM(count) as total FROM items GROUP BY category HAVING SUM(count) > 100
